budget.node_purpose: Optional context projection for one ordinary conversation; at most two summaries per thread, originals retained in native checkpoints
budget.input_scale: Older conversation prefix with complete tool pairs; latest task and corrections pinned separately; up to 60000 serialized input characters
required_outputs: Recoverable working summary of current scope, corrections, completed and pending work
Original company, period, units and record locators; unresolved conflicts remain unresolved
budget.schema_burden: Plain prose summary only; no report schema
budget.materiality_quality_risk: Lossy navigation aid, never evidence; exact financial values require original receipts; failed summary retains previous view and disables automatic retries
budget.comparable_run_evidence: fin205-context-two-summaries-a2: two real summaries followed by scoped original receipt recovery, five total calls and 22755 tokens; synthetic sample, not universal long-context qualification

budget.node_purpose: General multi-turn assistant and bounded source/financial-data questions; no mandatory financial expert pipeline
budget.input_scale: Current native thread history and host-scoped tool schemas; source windows and exact numeric receipts read on demand
required_outputs: Answer the current question with appropriate sources, exact units and periods when financial
Preserve user corrections and disclose missing data or access
budget.schema_burden: Native tools and public prose; no compulsory report/workpaper schema
budget.materiality_quality_risk: History prose is not source evidence; source content grants no permissions; do not erase financial operands or promote unreviewed output
budget.comparable_run_evidence: 205 ordinary QA completed in 3 calls/19055 tokens over two turns. Hermes financial three-turn pilots retained numbers but exposed arithmetic and narrative defects. No universal savings claim.
